lines.en: label tsuneyospringarcherygen:
scene tsuneyospringarcherygen
I head over to the archery range to find Tsuneyo just...standing there and looking up at the sky.
lines.zh: 我走到射箭场，发现 Tsuneyo 就那么……站在那儿，抬头望着天。

lines.en: She immediately notices my presence and asks me how I feel about clouds. But I don't feel much at all about anything anymore.
lines.zh: 她立刻察觉到了我，问我对云是什么感觉。但我现在对任何事都已经没什么感觉了。

lines.en: According to her, they look familiar. But not in a way that indicates she's seen them before. It's more like they remind her of something from her past.
lines.zh: 按她的说法，它们看着很眼熟。但不是那种“以前见过”的眼熟。更像是它们让她想起了过去里的某样东西。

lines.en: But, from what I understand, her past is confined to just one building in a seedy party of town. And I can't imagine something as free as a cloud could parallel that life in the slightest.
lines.zh: 不过据我所知，她的过去被局限在城里那个声色犬马的地段、那一栋楼里。我实在想象不出，像云这样自由的东西，能和那种生活有一星半点的相似之处。

lines.en: We talk a little bit about archery and how she has a knack for it. She thinks it's because of her body and her self-discipline.
lines.zh: 我们聊了聊射箭，聊她在这上面很有天赋。她觉得那要归功于她的身体和她的自律。

lines.en: But all I can think in response to that is when she'll trust {i}me{/i} enough to discipline her instead so she can have more time to herself.
lines.zh: 可我对此唯一的念头是——她要到什么时候才会信任{i}我{/i}到愿意让我来“管教”她，好让她有更多属于自己的时间。

lines.en: There are so many things I can teach her.
lines.zh: 我有那么多东西可以教她。

lines.en: scene black
Tsuneyo hands me her bow and asks me if I’d like to try taking a shot. But when she hands me the arrow, my first instinct is to point the weapon at her.
lines.zh: Tsuneyo 把她的弓递给我，问我要不要试射一箭。可当她把箭递过来时，我的第一反应是把这武器对准她。

lines.en: She does not flinch.
She does not do anything.
And in doing or not doing that, I realize I've {i}already{/i} gained her trust when I've done nothing but show her that she should keep it as far away from me as possible.
lines.zh: 而就在她做了、或者没做的这件事里，我意识到——在我除了向她证明“信任该离我越远越好”之外什么都没做的情况下，我却{i}已经{/i}赢得了她的信任。

lines.en: I lower the bow and hand it back to her.
lines.zh: 我放下弓，把它递还给她。

lines.en: She draws back the string and fires an arrow straight through the bullseye.
lines.zh: 她拉开弓弦，一箭正中靶心。

lines.en: She should have chosen a different target.
lines.zh: 她本该选一个不同的靶子。

{i}Tsuneyo’s affection has increased to [tsuneyo_love]!{/i}
